description: This Java class defines a UserService component responsible for user management operations such as creating, updating, and patching user information within a Spring framework application, interacting with repositories and handling user data and authentication groups.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for handling user management functionalities, including creating new users, updating existing user details, and patching user data.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided data, ensuring username and email uniqueness, encoding the password, and assigning a default 'USER' auth group.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the user's name, surname, email, and image URL based on the provided User object.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a partial update on the user's 'detalle' field.
